# TEMPLATE — the AGENT.md baton section

The block an adopting flow's AGENT.md carries.
Paste it as a section; replace the <slots> with
the flow's own names and charter words (the lead
files those — the shape is the template's, the
crew is the flow's). Delete this instruction block
on use.

---

## The baton (rotating-lead waves)

This flow runs under the baton template
(micaforge/baton-flow, template/TEMPLATE.md): one
constant lead, each wave led by a crew lane in
turn, the stick passing as a BATON.md packet and
returning for the lead's gate.

- **Lead (map + gates):** <seat name · chat> —
  <the lead's charter line, the flow's own words>
- **Crew, in rotation order:**
  1. <lane / seat> — <its bench: what waves it
     holds best>
  2. <lane / seat> — <…>
- **Consults (summoned, not stick-holders):**
  <lane / seat — the expertise it is summoned for>
- **The pass:** BATON.md in the wave's cycle
  folder; receipt = acceptance; no receipt in the
  named window → the stick stays with the lead and
  the gap is recorded.
- **The gate at return:** deliverables vs brief ·
  the holder's NEXT updated · intake filed or
  declared none. Verdict in the cycle record, in
  the act.
- **Intake:** EVOLUTION-INTAKE.md in this flow's
  home; entries filed as they surface; the fold
  cadence per the template.
